candidate_axiom.name: Hegelian Dialectical Synthesis & Antinomy Reconciliation
candidate_axiom.statement: When two candidate hypotheses assert mutually contradictory architectural constraints yet both demonstrate positive empirical delta, the system must synthesize a higher-order meta-axiom that preserves the operational validity of both within bounded contextual domains.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Competing axioms with orthogonal advantages are combined via contextual domain boundaries rather than greedy elimination.

system_profile.archetype: Dialectical Conflict Resolver & Contextual Sublation Mesh
system_profile.topology_type: Bifurcated Scope Mesh with Higher-Order Arbiter
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Thesis Invariant] ──┐
                     ├──> [Antinomy Comparator] ──> [Context Boundary Partitioner]
[Antithesis Invariant]┘                                      │
                                                             ▼
                                                [Higher-Order Unified Invariant]

Antinomy Comparator.role: Identifies formal opposition between valid hypotheses (e.g., pure immutability vs high-speed mutable cache).
Antinomy Comparator.invariant_rule: Only triggers when both opposing sides demonstrate strictly positive delta E.

Context Boundary Partitioner.role: Isolates execution scopes where each invariant holds true without conflict.
Context Boundary Partitioner.invariant_rule: Prevents leakage of mutable semantics into immutable verification domains.

Sublation Synthesizer.role: Compiles unified higher-order invariant reconciling both operational modes.
Sublation Synthesizer.invariant_rule: Composite aggregate efficacy must strictly exceed both individual theses.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Synthesizes novel hybrid architectures that transcend single-paradigm traps (+0.0160).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Resolves design stalemates without oscillating back and forth between extremes (+0.0090).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces resilient, dual-mode structural systems with high operational envelope (+0.0140).

tradeoffs.strengths: Recovers valuable insights from runner-up candidates rather than discarding them.
tradeoffs.constraints: Increases simulation depth required to verify multi-context boundary interactions.

leaderboard.name: Popperian Demarcation & Active Counter-Example Synthesis
leaderboard.statement: Any epistemic claim or invariant must provide an algorithmic refutation witness; hypotheses lacking computable falsification boundaries are demarcated as metaphysical and discarded prior to simulation.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Candidates that cannot synthesize an explicit negative counter-example test harness are discarded at validation ingress.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Hypothesis AST] ──> [Dual-Channel Parser]
                          │
           ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
           ▼                             ▼
[Affirmative Path]             [Adversarial Refutation Harness]
           │                             │
           └──────────────┬──────────────┘
                          ▼
            [Falsifiability Arbiter] ──> [Compile-Time Witness]

Adversarial Refutation Harness.role: Synthesizes boundary counter-inputs aimed at falsifying module assertions.
Adversarial Refutation Harness.invariant_rule: Must generate at least one non-trivial counter-example test case.

Falsifiability Arbiter.role: Executes candidates against refutation vectors to prove falsifiability.
Falsifiability Arbiter.invariant_rule: Tautological claims with zero failure states are rejected.

Counter-Example Tracer.role: Emits machine-readable diagnostic witnesses upon invariant breach.
Counter-Example Tracer.invariant_rule: Refutation failures must log minimal reproduction traces.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Forces hypothesis generator into high-entropy edge spaces to locate falsification witnesses (+0.0125).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Drastically accelerates rejection of vacuous, untestable claims without running deep simulations (+0.0180).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Filters out untestable structural proposals early, yielding clean compilable specifications (+0.0090).

tradeoffs.strengths: Completely eliminates unprovable or tautological architectural claims; provides automated regression tests.
tradeoffs.constraints: Adds slight compilation overhead due to automatic test-vector synthesis.

leaderboard.name: Algorithmic Occam's Razor & Minimum Description Length (MDL)
leaderboard.statement: Between competing hypotheses of equivalent empirical fit, the hypothesis minimizing joint description length of model plus compressed residuals is strictly selected; architectural bloat is penalized proportionally to AST Kolmogorov complexity.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Candidates introducing redundant abstractions without proportional reduction in residual entropy are penalized by the compiler.

system_profile.archetype: AST Kolmogorov Pruning & Joint Code-Length Minimizer
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Candidate Model AST] ──> [Kolmogorov Metric Evaluator]
                                 │
                                 ▼
                     [Residual Entropy Analyzer]
                                 │
                                 ▼
                   [Joint Code-Length Minimizer] ──> [Compact Verified Core]

AST Complexity Profiler.role: Measures description length L(H) in syntax tree nodes and operational token weights.
AST Complexity Profiler.invariant_rule: Penalizes unnecessary wrapper layers and pass-through proxies.

Residual Entropy Analyzer.role: Quantifies uncompressed variance in target outputs L(D|H).
Residual Entropy Analyzer.invariant_rule: Requires each added complexity unit to pay for itself in error reduction.

Isomorphism Collapser.role: Detects and merges redundant subsystem layers that perform isomorphic transformations.
Isomorphism Collapser.invariant_rule: Enforces strict canonical representation of state mutations.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Focuses search on lean, dense hypotheses rather than verbose variations (+0.0070).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Quickly rejects bloated hypotheses with excess degrees of freedom (+0.0150).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces ultra-lean, highly maintainable structural compilation specifications (+0.0160).

tradeoffs.strengths: Prevents architectural over-engineering; minimizes runtime instruction footprints.
tradeoffs.constraints: May penalize nascent abstractions that require multi-epoch composition to show benefit.
